name: Crumple
summary: Delete a draft invoice: it crumples into a paper ball, bounces off the basket rim and drops in
about: Crumple draws the invoice on a canvas and crushes it through a folding mesh, so the printed lines and PKR totals scrunch up with light and shadow on every crease. The ball is tossed in an arc, clips the rim of a woven basket and drops inside, where it stays peeking over the edge. Undo lifts it out, flies it back and smooths it flat, creases fading away.
how: Press Delete draft to crumple the top invoice and toss it in the basket.
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) within six seconds to take it back out.
The next draft slides up after each delete; the count updates.
Take all out empties the basket back onto the desk.
